rows.label: Dancing Plague of 1518
rows.description: 16th century mass dancing mania in Strasbourg
rows.hook: had townspeople unable to stop moving in a frenzy for weeks, with no agreed cause

rows.label: Flatwoods monster
rows.hook: is a tall, hooded humanoid said to have appeared on a rural hillside after a glowing object streaked by

rows.label: ball lightning
rows.description: extremely rare unexplained atmospheric electrical phenomenon
rows.hook: is a glowing sphere reported during storms that science has never fully explained

rows.label: will o' the wisp
rows.hook: is a flickering light that supposedly lures night travellers astray over bogs and marshes

rows.label: Skinwalker Ranch
rows.description: ranch in the Uintah Basin of Utah
rows.hook: is a Utah property reputed for UFO sightings and strange happenings, named for a Navajo legend

rows.label: extrasensory perception
rows.description: reception of information via extra senses
rows.hook: is the claimed ability to know things, like others' thoughts, through the mind alone

rows.label: unidentified flying object
rows.description: unusual apparent anomaly in the sky that is not readily identifiable
rows.hook: is anything strange in the sky that cannot be readily explained, often imagined as a saucer

rows.label: Philadelphia Experiment
rows.description: urban legend about a supposed US Naval experiment in 1943
rows.hook: is a legend claiming the Navy made a warship vanish and reappear far away

rows.label: spontaneous human combustion
rows.description: term encompassing reported cases of the combustion of a human body without an apparent external source of ignition
rows.hook: is the disputed idea that a living body can burst into flames with no outside spark

rows.label: near death experience
rows.description: personal experiences associated with impending death
rows.hook: is a profound episode of seeing a bright light and floating out of the body when close to dying

rows.label: Hollow Earth
rows.description: historical concept proposing that the planet Earth is entirely hollow or contains a substantial interior space
rows.hook: is the discredited notion that the planet's interior is a vast empty space, even home to hidden worlds

rows.label: Mokele-mbembe
rows.description: water-dwelling entity that supposedly lives in the Congo River Basin

rows.label: poltergeist
rows.description: type of ghost or spirit that moves physical objects.
rows.hook: is a noisy spirit blamed for flinging furniture and rattling things around a house
